description: Default permissions for the CodeDeck shell: SQLite persistence (in-crate sqlstore commands since CDX-012 — app commands need no capability entry), codedeck:// deep links, OS notifications, mic STT, the stay-connected foreground service, the mesh VpnService (nostr-vpn), and — since CDX-029 — plugin-http scoped to https for the Blossom image upload/download escape hatch (the WebView's CORS preflight is blocked by the server; the Blossom server URL is user-configurable at runtime, so the scope cannot be pinned to one host — note against CDX-016's CSP follow-up). SOCKS5 routing through Orbot is the native `client_runtime::Core`'s own transport config now, not a WebView capability. Everything else still talks to the world over Nostr websockets only.
